description: A Python script for monitoring system utilization including CPU, memory, GPU memory, and GPU utilization, with capabilities for GPU info collection via pynvml and amdsmi libraries, and logging in JSON format.

classes.name: UsageData
classes.description: Dataclass for storing system usage data including CPU, memory, processes, and GPU info.

classes.name: GpuData
classes.description: Dataclass for storing GPU-specific data such as UUID, utilization, memory utilization, and memory info.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for debug mode, log interval, and data collection interval.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing GPU libraries, parsing arguments, and starting the UsageLogger.
